notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 mask covered only a fragment of the leftmost car: new SAM3 mask = all visible cars of the gray passenger train on the far-left track (catenary pole and pedestrian excluded), recolour dark green. U2 blue door replaced by a 'blue door' (no-op): now attribute yellow on the first double sliding door behind the red cab. U3 nearest ornate platform lamppost. U4 gray electrical cabinet on the tall pole; payload specific.
